inference.unit: original question cluster with three recorded seeds retained together
inference.weights: GSM8K0.5 and BBH0.5; BBH questions weighted equally inside task
inference.scope: Approximate question-sampling generalization conditional on frozen models, present source mixture and recorded generations
inference.finite_pool: Complete evaluable finite-pool averages are observed values; bootstrap addresses question-sampling uncertainty
inference.degeneracy: An all-zero empirical subgroup yields [0,0] under resampling; this does not establish zero population effect
inference.missing_bounds: E18 deterministic missing-outcome ranges are retained separately and have no confidence level

interaction.effect: BBH TSPO-SPO gain minus GSM8K TSPO-SPO gain
interaction.role: Post-E18 exploratory task-by-policy heterogeneity; task assignment is observational

primary.user_reporting_override: Point estimates and paired t p-values only; confidence intervals and CI bootstrap are not computed
primary.method: equal-task-weighted paired t with Satterthwaite df
primary.guarantee: model-based independent-question inference, not unconditional finite-sample coverage
